component.name: Aura
component.summary: Mac-inspired modern App Store tailored exclusively for Hyprland on Arch Linux

description.p: Aura is an ultra-fast, minimal GTK4/libadwaita App Store designed specifically for Hyprland on Arch Linux and CachyOS, featuring an authentic macOS App Store aesthetic.

ul.li: Tailored specifically for Hyprland Wayland compositor with native floating rules
Instant fuzzy search across official Pacman repositories and AUR via Paru
Isolated OCI container sandbox using native Docker for desktop applications
Lifetime passwordless mode with encrypted local credentials vault
System updates manager with one-click batch upgrades
Liquid 60FPS fluid spring animations and macOS micro-interactions
